SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No. 8012
Section 1, Special Br. 2nd Subdiv.
REPORT
Date July 19, 1937.

Subject Communication dated 17.7.37 from the Netherlands Consulate-General
concerning Miss N.P. Nikiforoff.

Made by D.S.I. Prokofiev Forwarded by C. Goncalves. S.J.

Enquiries show that Miss Nadejda Pavlovna Nikiforoff,
Russian, was born on April 29, 1913 at Irkutsk, Siberia. She
is reported to have left Russia for China in 1920 together with
her parents and to have subsequently resided in Harbin until
1933, when the Nikiforoff family left for Dairen. In October,
1934 they arrived in Shanghai from Dairen and have since been
residing in this city.

In Shanghai Miss Nikiforoff is reported to have been
employed at a local library for a period, after which she was
engaged as a cashier by "D.D.'s Cafe-Restaurant, 815 Avenue
Joffre. She left this place of employment on July 1, 1937 in
order to proceed to the Netherlands Indies where she will
join her fiance.

Miss Nikiforoff's father, Mr. P.A. Nikiforoff, has been
employed as a superintendent of the Russian "White Flower
Society's Home for Tuberculars", 61 Rue Paul Henry, from 1935
and resides at the above address together with his family.

Nothing detrimental is known to this office regarding
Miss Nikiforoff or her parents.

They are registered with the Russian Emigrants' Committee,
118/1 Moulmein Road.

A. Prokofiev
D. S. I.

el.
D.C. (Special Branch)

档案编号 8012
特别分部第二分区第1组。
报告
日期：1937年7月19日。

事由：荷兰总领事馆1937年7月17日来函，
涉及N.P.尼基福罗夫小姐。

由警探长普罗科菲耶夫（D.S.I. Prokofiev）制作，由S.J.贡萨尔维斯（C. Goncalves. S.J.）转呈。

经查，娜杰日达·帕夫洛夫娜·尼基福罗夫小姐（Miss Nadejda Pavlovna Nikiforoff），
俄国人，1913年4月29日出生于西伯利亚伊尔库茨克。据报，她
于1920年随父母离开俄国前往中国，随后在哈尔滨居住至
1933年，之后尼基福罗夫一家前往大连。1934年10月，
他们从大连抵达上海，此后一直居住在本市。

据悉，尼基福罗夫小姐在上海曾受雇于当地一家图书馆，为期一段时间，之后被
霞飞路815号“D.D.咖啡馆餐厅”（D.D.'s Cafe-Restaurant, 815 Avenue Joffre）聘为收银员。她于1937年7月1日离职，
以便前往荷属东印度群岛与未婚夫会合。

尼基福罗夫小姐的父亲P.A.尼基福罗夫先生自1935年起
受雇担任保罗·亨利路61号俄国“白花社结核病患者之家”（Russian "White Flower Society's Home for Tuberculars"）的主管，
并与家人居住于上述地址。

本局对尼基福罗夫小姐或其父母无任何不利记录。

他们在莫尔缅路118/1号俄国侨民委员会登记注册。

A. 普罗科菲耶夫
警探长

el.
代主管（特别分部）

SHANGHAI, 3rd July 1937 .
8012
18 7 37

Sir,

I have the honour to inform you that Miss Nadejda
NIKIFOROVA has applied to this Consulate General for a visé
for admission into the Netherlands Indies.

She is in possession of a passport issued by the Bureau
of Public Safety at Shanghai on the 30th June 1937, valid
for the Netherlands Indies, via Manila and Singapore.

She states that she has been residing in Harbin for
about 15 years and in Shanghai since 1935. Her private
address in Shanghai is 61 Rue Paul Henri. She was born
at Irkutsk in 1913.

Miss Nikiforova intends to sail on the s.s.Potsdam,
leaving Shanghai on the 23rd July. Upon arrival at Belawan-
Deli (Sumatra), she intends to contract a marriage with Mr.
J.M.Kruys, an employee of the Netherlands Trading Society,
at Medan, who has been residing in Shanghai during the
years 1935-1936.

I should be much obliged to you if you would let me
know, if possible, whether anything is known against this
person from a political or moral point of view.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,
(sd.) H.Riemens.
Vice-Consul.

Major K.M.Bourne,
Officer i/c Special Branch,
Shanghai Municipal Police,

SHANGHAI.

D.S.J. Gokhale S.I.
C/18 DBR
18/7

S/B

荷兰驻华中总领事馆
电话地址：HOLLANDIA。

第2166号。

副本。
1937年7月17日

上海，1937年7月3日。
8012
18 7 37

先生：

谨此通知阁下，娜杰日达·
尼基福罗娃小姐（Miss Nadejda NIKIFOROVA）已向本总领事馆申请
进入荷属东印度群岛的签证。

她持有上海工部局警务处于1937年6月30日签发的护照，
经马尼拉和新加坡前往荷属东印度群岛有效。

她声称在哈尔滨居住约15年，自1935年起在上海居住。她在上海的私人住址是保罗·亨利路61号。她于
1913年出生在伊尔库茨克。

尼基福罗娃小姐计划乘坐“波茨坦”号轮船（s.s.Potsdam），
该船将于7月23日离开上海。抵达棉兰老岛-
德里（苏门答腊）后，她打算与J.M.克鲁伊斯先生（Mr. J.M.Kruys）结婚，克鲁伊斯先生是荷兰贸易公司（Netherlands Trading Society）的职员，
在棉兰工作，1935-1936年间曾居住在上海。

如蒙告知，是否从政治或道德角度知晓对此人
有任何不利情况，本人将不胜感激。

谨致，
先生，
您顺从的仆人，
(签名) H.里门斯。
副领事。

K.M.伯恩少校，
特别分部主管，
上海公共租界工部局警务处，

上海。

S.I. Gokhale D.S.J.
C/18 DBR
18/7

S/B
（印：办公室 1937年7月17日 上海）
